name: Pet sitting
summary: How expats arrange pet sitting in Singapore — in-home vs boarding alternatives, AVS licensing cues, condo pet rules, and holiday coverage planning.
body:
Pet sitting covers drop-in visits, in-home overnight stays, and some daycare hybrids when owners travel. Condo by-laws and neighbour noise tolerance shape what is realistic. Boarding remains a backup when sitters are scarce over peak holidays.

## Formats
- Drop-in feeding and litter / walk visits
- In-home overnight sitting
- Dog walking add-ons on workdays
- Medication administration protocols
- Backup sitter lists for illness days

Meet-and-greets before the trip are non-negotiable.

## How to choose
Prefer sitters who share ID, emergency vet contacts, and written visit logs. Ask about AVS-related licensing where boarding is involved. Confirm keys / access-card handling and photo updates cadence.

## Practical tip
Leave a one-page care sheet on the counter: feeding amounts, walks, meds, and the nearest 24-hour clinic. WhatsApp threads fail at 2 a.m.
